platform.name: SENZ App
platform.principle: SENZ combines human strategic judgment with useful technology.
platform.purpose: The SENZ App is where licensed customers use SENZ software. The website explains the products and takes inquiries; the app opens a product only after SENZ verifies payment or a signed agreement.

available.label: Available
available.meaning: Released and supported for licensed customers.

beta.label: Beta
beta.meaning: Working for licensed pilot customers, with its limitations disclosed. Feedback shapes the release.

custom.label: Custom implementation
custom.meaning: Set up for each client under a signed agreement and quotation.

in_development.label: In development
in_development.meaning: Built and tested by SENZ but not yet offered to customers. Ask for a demonstration.

retired.label: Retired
retired.meaning: No longer offered to new customers; existing licenses keep working until they end.

products.name: SENZ AI Workspace
products.purpose: Turn your own notes, goals, and source text into usable first drafts, and keep every version.
products.audience: Professionals, small businesses, and teams who write every day.
includes: Seven drafting tools: email, summary, rewrite, action items, FAQ, plan, and comparison
Refine with AI, edit by hand, and restore any earlier version
Search your documents and export them as Markdown or plain text
products.limits: Uses only what you provide. It does not browse the web, send, or publish anything, and every draft needs human review.
products.summary: Draft, summarize, rewrite, and structure real work with saved, versioned outputs.

products.name: SENZ Communications Intelligence
products.purpose: Prepare important messages properly: plan them, check them, and approve them before they go out.
products.audience: Communications officers, schools, local governments, agencies, and organizations.
includes: Six structured tools: message brief, stakeholder plan, clarity and tone review, campaign narrative, issue and crisis preparation, and communications diagnostic
Human approval required before export; every new version needs approval again
Optional SENZ strategic review of a version you choose to share
products.limits: It does not publish or send messages, and it does not replace legal advice or a crisis team.
products.summary: Message briefs, stakeholder plans, clarity reviews, and issue preparation with human approval.

products.name: SENZ Digital Assistant
products.purpose: Answer the questions people keep asking on your website, using only answers you approve, and pass anything else to a person.
products.audience: Businesses, schools, clinics, venues, and organizations with repeat questions.
includes: An approved-knowledge library that you control
Answers that cite their sources; unanswerable questions become handoff requests to your team
An embed code that works only on the websites you allow, with pause and unpublish at any time
products.limits: It never answers outside your approved knowledge, and it does not take payments or make bookings.
products.summary: An assistant that answers only from your approved knowledge and hands off to a person.

products.name: SENZ FotoLab
products.purpose: Keep your photos in private projects and make careful edits without ever losing the original.
products.audience: Individuals and small teams who prepare their own images.
includes: Private photo projects with a rights acknowledgement for every upload
Exposure, brightness, contrast, saturation, crop, resize, rotate, and flip, each saved as a new version
Originals kept untouched; download any version
products.limits: A self-service editor, not a retouching service by SENZ staff. It does not generate or alter images with AI.
products.summary: Private photo projects with real non-destructive adjustments, versions, and export.

products.name: SENZ Client Portal
products.purpose: One private place for a contracted project between SENZ and a client: what is due, what was delivered, and what was approved.
products.audience: SENZ clients working under a signed project agreement.
includes: Milestones and deliverables with version history
Comments, revision requests, approvals, and client uploads
Final delivery with a record of who approved what and when
products.limits: Set up by SENZ for each contract. It is not a general CRM, form builder, or public file-sharing service.
products.summary: Contracted project workspace for milestones, deliverables, revisions, and approvals.

products.name: SENZ Event Systems
products.purpose: Run event registration from announcement to the door: take sign-ups within capacity, manage a waitlist, and check people in.
includes: A public registration page with capacity limits and an automatic waitlist
Single-use check-in codes that block duplicate entry
Attendee export and deletion of attendee data after the event
products.limits: It does not sell tickets or run voting or tabulation.
products.summary: Event publishing, capacity-safe RSVP, waitlists, check-in, and attendee export.

products.name: SENZ Digital Representative
products.purpose: Let a brand or person be represented by a clearly disclosed text assistant that speaks only from approved information, and only while consent is in place.
products.audience: Public figures, brands, and organizations under a signed agreement.
includes: Recorded, revocable consent with an evidence reference
Answers only from approved knowledge, always disclosed as automated
Publication stops immediately when consent is revoked
products.limits: Text only. It has no voice or video likeness and is never presented as the real person.
products.summary: Consent-based, disclosed text representative for a brand or person, with human approval.

products.name: SENZ Music Platform
products.purpose: Review and deliver music projects privately: listen to protected previews, give timestamped feedback, confirm rights, then release the files.
products.audience: Artists, producers, and clients working with SENZ under a music project agreement.
includes: Protected audio previews with version history
Timestamped feedback and approvals
Downloads unlocked only after rights are confirmed and the project is delivered
products.limits: It does not stream music to the public, publish charts, or generate music.
products.summary: Protected audio previews, timestamped feedback, rights confirmation, and delivery.
